Internship AB Inbev (Jupiler, Corona, Flying Fish, ...) - Brand management - 3 to 6 months - Leuven 
 
#Talent 
 
Purpose: 
 
Brewing the world's most loved beers and building brands consumers love, AB InBev is where ownership, ambition, and action thrive. 
 
We empower you to dream big, lead change, and create a long-lasting legacy. 
 
We value relentless problem-solvers who take accountability, embrace challenges, and turn bold goals into results through resilience and hard work. 
 
That's Who We Are: Come and OWN IT. 
 
Internship description: 
 
The purpose of the role is to assist the Senior Brand Manager(s) in driving growth for one of our key brands [Jupiler, Corona or Flying Fish].  

Our Brand teams bridge the gap between supporting brand building, brand activations, campaigns, and consumer engagement. We're looking for a proactive and ambitious students to join us and gain hands-on experience in one of the most dynamic and exciting industries. This is more than just an internship - it's a chance to start your career with us. Outstanding interns will be considered for full-time roles post-graduation. 
 
What will you do during the internship? 

• Assist with planning and follow-up of activations and campaigns  
• Support creation of marketing materials and content  
• Analyze consumer trends and competitor activities  
• Share insights on the lifestyle, habits, and culture of younger adult consumers  
• Work closely with sales, trade marketing, and external partners  
 
Internship duration: 
 
Flexible start date between October and December 2026, minimum 3 months and maximum 6 months.  
 
Work environment 
 
Work from our GHQ office in Leuven. The office is just a ten-minute walk from the Leuven train station.  

Compensation: 
 
Unpaid (with potential for full-time employment post-internship) 
 
What we're looking for: 

• Students with strong knowledge of their own consumer world and peer culture  
• Curious, creative, digitally fluent  
• Interest in marketing and consumer trends  
• Proactive, hands-on, team-oriented  
• Strong communication and organizational skills  
• You are fluent in English and Dutch or French 
• You are proficient in Excel and PowerPoint; experience with Nielsen is a plus. 
• You have an internship agreement from your University. 
 
 
 
Why build your career with us: 
 
We recruit for mindset, ambition, cultural fit, and growth opportunities. 
 
UNIQUE CULTURE  
We are proud to be part of something bigger than ourselves and are passionate about building upon our company's long legacy. We believe in collaboration and candor, which results in a dynamic culture with open communication. 
  
BRANDS EVERYONE LOVES  
We are part of the collective, global history of beer. We are the proud makers of more than 500 iconic brands, from beloved international classics to local favorites. 
 
GROWTH OPPORTUNITIES  
Our people grow at the pace of their talent. We empower our people to learn, expand their perspectives, and unlock career growth. 
 
If this sounds like the incredible opportunity you've been waiting for, apply today.

Plouvier Group is looking for a Safety Advisor to join our team.
 

With 
20 vessels and 165 colleagues, Plouvier operates a modern inland tanker fleet across Europe. We are looking for an experienced QHES professional with a strong background in 
ADN, dangerous goods and inland tanker operations.
 

As 
ADN Safety Advisor, you will play an important role in maintaining regulatory compliance and continuously improving QHES standards across our fleet.
 

Your role
 

You will be responsible for ensuring that our vessels, procedures and documentation remain compliant with 
ADN and applicable inland shipping regulations.
 

Your key responsibilities include:
 
 

• Ensuring 
ADN compliance across the fleet. 

• Acting as 
ADN Safety Advisor and providing practical guidance to vessel crews. 

• Monitoring regulatory developments and translating them into clear procedures. 

• Conducting and reviewing 
risk assessments, work permits and safety procedures. 

• Supporting incident and near-miss investigations and corrective actions. 

• Maintaining accurate and traceable 
QHES and ADN documentation. 

• Working with Captains, crew and Superintendents through 
focus groups to identify risks and improve procedures. 

• Supporting 
SIRE/VIQ, BIQ, TMSA, OCIMF and ADN audits and inspections.  

 

Your profile
 

We are looking for someone who combines strong 
ADN knowledge with practical experience in the maritime or inland shipping sector.
 

You have:
 
 

• A valid 
ADN Safety Advisor certificate. 

• Practical experience with 
ADN and dangerous goods. 

• Experience in 
inland tanker shipping is highly valued. 

• Knowledge of QHES, HSE and 
Safety Management Systems (SMS). 

• Experience with risk assessments, incident investigations and audits. 

• Excellent attention to detail and strong organisational skills. 

• The ability to turn regulations into practical solutions for vessel crews. 

• Fluent English, German and Dutch 

• A Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant experience. 

• Experience with SIRE/VIQ, TMSA or OCIMF is an advantage.

•

Managing communications: Answering phones professionally and routing calls as necessary (EN/NL/FR).

jobs.employer_name: Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels NV
jobs.description:
Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is a subsidiary of Safran Aircraft Engines, based at Brussels Airport (Zaventem & Steenokkerzeel, Belgium), specialized in the inspection, maintenance and repair (MRO) of the advanced LEAP jet engines that power the latest generation of the Airbus A320NEO & Boeing B737MAX narrow body families. The company is a key player in the integrated CFM international MRO network. With more than 75 years of experience, and up to 20 international Part 145 certifications (EASA/ FAA/ CAAC/ …), Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is recognized as a worldwide center of expertise in the air transport industry. More than a 100 airlines, lessors, private aircraft operators and MRO partners have entrusted their engines to our company. We employ over 600 highly skilled, passionate and enthusiastic employees.

To strengthen our Supply Chain department, we are looking for a Team Leader Configuration & Marshalling.

The Configuration & Marshalling Team Leader ensures effective preparation, coordination, and follow-up of the team's activities in compliance with company standards and procedures. The role involves allocating work according to weekly objectives and priorities set by the Completion Manager, while also actively participating in daily operational activities and supporting the team when required.

Your role:
Reporting to the Completion Manager your main tasks and responsibilities are:
Team Management:

• Lead and coordinate daily team activities
• Identify problems, perform root cause analysis, and implement solutions
• Allocate resources based on priorities and objectives
• Monitor skills and ensure development plans
• Ensure compliance with quality standards and company rules
• Manage shift handovers

Daily Operations:

• Perform configuration and marshalling tasks
• Act as technical reference
• Train new employees
• Provide operational backup when needed
Communication & Continuous Improvement:

• Report key issues to the Completion Manager
• Communicate effectively within the team
• Contribute to process improvements

Your profile:

• Secondary education or equivalent experience
• Knowledge of aircraft engine components
• Understanding of quality systems and processes
• ERP and IT proficiency
• Team management skills
• Awareness of logistics risks
• Able to manage priorities and urgent issues
• Able to identify anomalies and suggest improvements
• Working knowledge of French and English required

Candidates must be legally authorized to work in Belgium, holding either an EU passport or a valid work & residence permit. Please note that we do not provide assistance with visa or permit applications.

Our client is an international logistics leader and is looking for an Air Export Administrative Agent to strengthen their Air Export Team in the Machelen region.

Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels, a subsidiary of Safran Aircraft Engines, is located at Brussels Airport (Zaventem & Steenokkerzeel, Belgium). We specialize in the inspection, maintenance, and repair (MRO) of the advanced LEAP jet engines that power the latest generation of the Airbus A320NEO & Boeing B737MAX narrow body families. 

Over the past years, we have successfully expanded our team of Jet Engine Mechanics. As we continue to grow, we are now looking for a limited number of additional mechanics who combine strong technical skills, precision and a genuine passion for aircraft engines. As a Jet Engine Mechanic, you will ensure the airworthiness and performance of LEAP engines through maintenance, disassembly & assembly. Your responsibilities include:

• Managing engine induction into the workshop and reporting defects or damage
• Dismantling and assembling engine modules
• Ensuring compliance with quality, safety, and environmental requirements
• Participating in continuous improvement projects
• Completing technical documentation for traceability
• Reporting anomalies in work instructions and proposing improvements

• Technical high school diploma in mechanics, aeronautics or a related field

• A high level of precision, ownership and attention to detail
• A strong quality and safety mindset
• Curiosity, motivation and a willingness to continuously learn

You see electrical malfunctions as challenges, read wiring diagrams with ease, and work according to the latest technical guidelines. You communicate clearly with customers and manufacturers about your work and support our branch in Herent when needed.

Your day starts in a fully equipped workshop where you collaborate with a young, dynamic team. You begin by planning the necessary repairs, running diagnostics with advanced equipment, and ensuring every truck is safe and ready for the road. You coordinate colleagues and provide technical support, helping the whole team deliver top results.

Ready to take the next step in your career as a mechanic? Apply today and let our enthusiastic team guide you as you grow and thrive!

• You have a technical diploma (A3/A2) in automotive mechanics or equivalent experience

• Experience in leading a team is an advantage

• A C(E) driver’s license is an asset but not required

As a Night Customer Service Agent, you will be the main point of contact for customers, workshops and other parties involved in breakdown assistance. You will ensure that requests are handled efficiently and that every case is followed up accurately.

Your main responsibilities will include:

 
• 
Handling incoming phone calls and customer inquiries.

 
• 
Managing emails and providing clear and professional responses.

 
• 
Gathering information and checking data for accuracy and completeness.

 
• 
Providing first-line technical support and communicating with workshops.

 
• 
Keeping customers and all relevant parties informed about the progress of their case.

 
• 
Following up and monitoring agreements with all parties involved.

 
• 
Managing contract-related issues within the agreed deadlines.

 
• 
Managing several cases and requests simultaneously while maintaining a high level of service.

 
• 
Taking the appropriate action in urgent or unexpected situations.

Working hours

This is a night position with a specific and attractive work schedule.

You will work:

 
• 
3 nights per week

 
• 
From 20:00 until 08:00

 
• 
The rest of the week is free

This schedule offers a great work-life balance, with several days off during the week.

Night shifts are compensated with additional night premiums.

Flexibility regarding the three scheduled night shifts is essential for this position.

Your profile

We are looking for someone who is customer-focused, communicative and able to multitask, while remaining calm and professional during the night.

Knowledge & experience

 
• 
Very good English – essential and the main working language.

 
• 
Good knowledge of French.

 
• 
Good knowledge of Dutch.

 
• 
Good knowledge of Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook, etc.).

 
• 
Previous experience in customer service, administration or case management is a strong asset.

 
• 
Technical knowledge of the automotive sector, tyres or mechanics is a plus, but not required.

 
• 
No specific experience is required, as training will be provided.

Skills & personality

 
• 
Excellent telephone communication skills.

 
• 
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.

 
• 
Naturally customer-oriented and service-minded.

 
• 
Able to multitask and manage several cases at the same time.

 
• 
Accurate, organised and committed to delivering high-quality work.

 
• 
Stress-resistant and able to remain calm in challenging situations.

 
• 
Comfortable working independently during night shifts.

 
• 
Flexible and quick to adapt to new situations and procedures.

 
• 
Reliable, responsible and eager to learn.

I-The role
Based in our Brussels office, you will work in close, direct collaboration with the Global Director of Brand & Digital Marketing and the wider international Marketing team, to ensure the consistency, quality and visibility of digital content across our hotels' distribution and booking platforms. As the central point of contact for content moderation group-wide, you will safeguard the brand's online image, editorial and legal compliance, and user experience across all of the collection's websites. This role offers an excellent opportunity to work at the heart of international hotel digital marketing, online distribution platforms, and content optimization for search engines and AI-powered tools.

II-Key responsibilities

A.Collection knowledge
-Develop an in-depth understanding of the hotels in the collection, their positioning and unique features.
-Become fully familiar with the group's brand standards and digital ecosystem.

B.Digital content audits
-Conduct detailed audits of content across the official website, booking engine, OTAs (Booking.com, Expedia, etc.), Google Business Profile, B2B/MICE platforms (Cvent) and other partner platforms.

C.Content harmonization and updates
-Ensure consistency of information across platforms: hotel descriptions, room categories and names, amenities and services, visual content and photo libraries, editorial tone and brand image.
-Continuously update and optimize content.

D.Search engine and AI model (LLM) optimization
-Optimize content structure and markup (structured data, schema.org, llms.txt files, FAQ content, etc.) to maximize visibility and accuracy across search engines and generative AI tools (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, Copilot, etc.).
-Regularly audit how the collection's hotels are represented in AI-generated answers, identify gaps or inaccurate information, and coordinate corrections.
-Support the improvement of quality and standardization of hotel data to help AI systems interpret it correctly.

E.Monitoring and continuous improvement in generative AI
-Actively track the fast-moving evolution of large language models (LLMs) and AI-powered search tools, along with emerging best practices (GEO ¿ Generative Engine Optimization, AEO ¿ Answer Engine Optimization).
-Translate this ongoing monitoring into concrete recommendations and continuously adjust content strategy as algorithms and tools evolve.
-Share learnings and best practices with the Marketing team and other stakeholders across the group. F.Liaison with the collection's hotels
-Act as the main point of contact for hotel properties' local teams for the collection, validation and regular updating of their content (information, photos, offers, events).
-Maintain regular follow-up with each property to ensure responsiveness, reliability and freshness of content across all platforms.

G.Content moderation and quality control
-Moderate, review and approve all content published on the collection's hotel websites prior to going live.
-Ensure compliance with editorial guidelines, brand standards, legal requirements and accessibility norms across all platforms.
 

H.Technical and cross-functional coordination
-Work with IT/web development teams, hotel properties and external agencies to resolve technical issues (broken links, outdated pages, faulty forms).
-Coordinate translation and localization of content across the collection's markets and languages.
-Manage a publishing calendar and prioritize update requests coming from individual properties.

I.Monitoring, reporting and continuous improvement
-Provide regular reporting on content quality, compliance and performance (KPIs, dashboards).
-Stay current on best practices in content moderation, SEO and user experience.
 
-Degree in Marketing, Digital Marketing, Communications, Hospitality Management or a related field.
-First experience in web content management or moderation, ideally within the hospitality, travel, or a multi-site environment.
-Experience with one or more CMS platforms (WordPress or equivalent) and web analytics tools (Google Analytics, Search Console).
-Excellent attention to detail, rigor, and a strong sense of editorial and legal compliance.
-Genuine interest in the hospitality industry and digital environments.
-Strong analytical and coordination skills, comfortable managing multiple priorities across a multi-market environment.
-Proficiency with digital platforms and content management tools.
-Genuine curiosity about generative AI technologies (LLMs) and their impact on digital discoverability; willingness to continuously learn in this fast-evolving field.
-Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, comfortable liaising with multiple stakeholders (hotels, internal teams, external partners).
-Excellent written and spoken French and English; any additional language is an asset.
 
Type: Sales and Marketing

Localisation: Bruxelles

Type de contrat: CDI

Contrat: Temps plein

Expérience: Moins d'1 an

Langue(s): Français, Anglais

jobs.description:
We're looking for candidates interested in a potential role as Logistical Field Representative. This person will be the face to the customer, overseeing the logistics chain between Airbus Helicopters and our customer, including stock and R&O service follow-up.
Responsibilities & Main Result Areas

In-Service Support Package

• 
Ensure timely replenishment of stock in line with contractual obligations.

• 
Coordinate the pickup and on-time delivery of R&O items, aligned with the customer’s maintenance planning.

• 
Actively participate in logistical management meetings.

• 
Manage both the Contractor’s and Customer’s prepositioned stocks, ensuring the follow-up and timely replenishment or revalidation of life-limited items.

• 
Oversee the replenishment and updating of Deployment Kits in close coordination with the MoD.

• 
Represent the MoD in interactions with the Contractor when required.

• 
Manage critical spare parts matters and support performance reporting in line with contractual KPIs, in close collaboration with the MoD.

Customer Relationship

• 
Act as the primary point of contact for the customer.

• 
Possess a solid understanding of the contractual framework and operate effectively within its scope.

• 
Professionally represent the collaboration between AH and the customer, ensuring clear communication and alignment.

Reporting

• 
Ensure timely and accurate reporting of contractual activities to the Contract Manager.

• 
Monitor and follow up on logistical discrepancies, escalating issues when necessary.

• 
Work closely with the Customer CAMO to ensure proper maintenance planning, particularly regarding spares and exchange items.

Experience

• 
Minimum 3 year of relevant experience in a supply chain or logistical role  

• 
Experience in aviation MRO is an advantage.

• 
Experience with customer relations

Skills

• 
ICT literate (MS Office)

• 
Basic understanding of Part-145 and CAMO regulations

• 
Comfortable in interacting with the customer daily

• 
Languages:

• 
English: fluent in understanding – writing – speaking is a must

• 
Knowledge of Dutch and French language is an advantage

• 
Valid European car driver's license

For our client, a biotech company that is a fast-growing & innovative organization, we are looking for a warehouse associate.
 

This position is part of our talent pool. We are not actively recruiting for this position at the moment, but we will carefully keep track of your application and contact you when the role becomes available again.
 

As a warehouse associate your responsibilities are; 
 
 
 
• Receiving biohazard products (blood bags, viral vectors, ...) in a controlled temperature environment. 
 
• Accurately process inventory receipts ensuring correct matching to purchase orders, documentation of approvals, quality checks and adherence to policies.  
 
• Working with equipment and material stored at cryogenic  
 
• Fill out the Master Inspection Checks (MIC) for incoming materials including: transport unloading, temperature control, integrity control, administrative paperwork related to following correct procedures.  
 
• Fill in forms & logbooks related to receiving, picking and outbound activities to comply with Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) and Good Documentation Practices (GDP) policies in the pharmaceutical environment.  
 
• Work closely together with the Operations and Quality department to support the Production and Lab activities for our start-up site.  
 
• Work in a clean environment where you will wear dedicated gowning clothes.  
 
• Working in two SAP Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems to process inbound, picking and outbound activities.  
 
• Collaborate with accounting, suppliers and business stakeholders in support of on-going operational efficiency efforts. 

 
 
• Associate’s degree or High-School Diploma.  
 
• You have relevant warehouse experience with a strong affinity to the pharmaceutical environment.  
 
•  Detail oriented character with a strong affinity to perform administrative work, fill out forms, logbooks, follow regular trainings.  
 
• You have an ability to interact and communicate effectively at all levels of the organization and across different functions.  
 
• You are a problem solver and have strong analytical and data skills. 
 
• You follow the procedures strictly to ensure both product quality and personal health & safety are followed at all times.  
 
• Ability to work independently and successfully. 
 
• You speak very good English or Dutch.
